title: Butter
notes: This chapter is tightly structured and symbolically dense, chaining butter from the churn through remnant diet, Job’s steps, wilderness provision, counterfeit speech, and Jael’s dish with a clear true/counterfeit contrast. The voice stays assertive, law-positive, and free of stock AI diction. Residual defects are presenter staging (“mark”), two author-prose sentences that open with And, a missing preposition inside the Hebrews link text, and light meta-hedging on the water register. All proposed fixes are surgical, preserve doctrine, scripture quotes, and AsciiDoc markup, and restore house style without reopening symbols.

proposals.old: the discernment link:/books/symbolic-language/introduction/[Hebrews assigns the strong-meat eater] (Hebrews 5:14).
proposals.new: the discernment link:/books/symbolic-language/introduction/[Hebrews assigns to the strong-meat eater] (Hebrews 5:14).
proposals.rationale: “Hebrews assigns the strong-meat eater” is ungrammatical; the required English is “assigns to.” The change is confined to the link text and leaves the surrounding claim and footnote untouched.

proposals.old: And mark the third symbol: the hidden thing is *swords*, and the sword is the word — __“the sword of the Spirit, which is the *word of God*”__ (Ephesians 6:17).
proposals.new: The third symbol is the hidden thing: *swords*, and the sword is the word — __“the sword of the Spirit, which is the *word of God*”__ (Ephesians 6:17).
proposals.rationale: House style forbids both sentence-initial “And” in author prose and presenter staging of the “Mark that” family. The rewrite keeps the identical claim and all markup.

proposals.old: Whether the asked-for water carries the living-water register is a question this book leaves open; the escalation itself — water, milk, butter — runs the symbol's whole ladder in one verse.
proposals.new: Whether the asked-for water carries the living-water register remains open; the escalation itself — water, milk, butter — runs the symbol's whole ladder in one verse.
proposals.rationale: House style rejects hedging and meta-talk that names the book leaving questions open. The shortened form retains the author’s deliberate openness without the register slip.

proposals.old:
Taste what is set before you, and mark whether it was churned — or merely smoothed.
And the meat on the same table has its counterfeit too — the flesh that presents clean and is not — and it is the next chapter.
proposals.new:
Taste what is set before you, whether it was churned — or merely smoothed.
The meat on the same table has its counterfeit too — the flesh that presents clean and is not — and it is the next chapter.
proposals.rationale: Both “mark whether” and the following “And” violate house style (director cues and sentence-open rules). The revision keeps the food-theme imperative, the true/counterfeit contrast, and the chapter transition intact.
